title: Teppo Felin and Matthias Holweg's 'Theory Is All You Need'. The Wind Tunnel Is All You Need.
short_version: Felin and Holweg say the Wright brothers prove humans reason from theory where AI predicts from data. Langley held the same belief, with $50,000 behind it, and went into the Potomac twice. What separated them was a wind tunnel. Belief is free. The experiment is the scarce thing.
